Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs because the constructor of the SeniorClass calls the overridable method 'toString' on 'this'. When a JuniorClass object is created, the constructor of SeniorClass is called first, leading 'toString' to execute on an incompletely initialized JuniorClass object. As 'name' is not yet initialized, calling 'name.toUpperCase()' results in a NullPointerException.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by creating an instance of JuniorClass, which indirectly calls an overridable method toString() during the construction of its superclass SeniorClass, leading to a NullPointerException.
